plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Spanish, Associate of Arts' program page (Major Code: 1315R), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/2024-2025-catalog/english-language-and-philosophy-department/spanish/spanish-associate-of-arts . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the published requirement tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals).  TRUE award: Associate of Arts (page title). Catalog year 2024-2025: the newest CSI catalog with complete published program pages found (a 2025-2026 catalog exists but its program pages were not locatable; the 2024-2025 pages are complete and officially published). Total credits: 63, the catalog's published minimum ('Total Credit Hours: 63-64'); semester tables print 16/16/17/14-15 and sum exactly at the minimum path. Variable credit: 'SCIG GE Any Gen. Ed. Science Course 3-4 Credits' in Spring Sophomore modeled at 3 (minimum-credit path). Choice slots: SUR LIT - any three of the six survey courses (ENGL 257/258/267/268/277/278), 3 cr each; FOR LANG - 'Any Selected Foreign Language Course', 4 cr each semester (the page's second-language sequence: FREN 101/102, PORT 101/102, or SIGL 101/102/201/202, 8 credits); COMM GE / SOCS GE / SCIG GE / SOCS GE2 / WELL GE / MATH GE / SCIG GE2 are official catalog placeholders (student choice). Footnotes: Social Science courses must be from 2 different disciplines; Science courses must be from 2 different disciplines. The catalog notes 'Alternative plans of study available by contacting your advisor.' Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page; per-course prerequisites live on the official catalog course pages, not the plan page.
